plugins.name: agora
plugins.description: A self-organizing polity of parallel AI coding-agent sessions on one repo — coordinate via hooks, @mentions, a (per-squad) team barrier, a task ledger, fan-in, a hub-and-spoke lead, an advisory constitution + parliament, cross-CLI bridges, and token tracking. (Formerly groupchat.)
